messages:
Nina: Heads up everyone 10am next Tue is Maya's birthday. Quick options: surprise morning donut run (I can pick them up) or a cozy chai circle + tiny desk plants? Remote folks we'll stream a 5min teachat. Vote with reactions (:doughnut: = donuts, :tea: = chai + plant).
Omar: Donuts sound great but can we do one GF/DF box? Also nuts-free please.
Nina: Yep will order one GF/DF box and label the trays.
Liam: I can make a short playlist of Maya's fav songs for the morning if we do donuts 3B6
Priya: I vote :tea: 375 plants are cute and low-maintenance. Also good for the office air.
Sam: If we do plants what size? Desk succulents or little potted herbs?
Nina: Thinking small succulents (easy care). If folks prefer herb pots I can get basil too.
ConfettiBot: Confetti loaded for: Maya (user id U04). Trigger on 2026-07-14 09:58.
Omar: Remote folks could get a $10 e-gift for a plant or tea voucher?
Priya: +1 on e-gift option, makes it inclusive.
Nina: Good call. I'll budget for a $10 remote voucher and ask folks in the event RSVP which they prefer.
Liam: Can we do a hybrid: donuts at 9:30 for those early, then chai circle at 10 for folks who prefer quiet? Keeps energy flexible.
Priya: That works for me.
Sam: Quiet chai circle please. I'll pass on the donuts.
Nina: Plan: 9:309:45 donuts (optional), 10:0010:15 chai circle + plant handouts. Zoom opens 9:55 for remote. I'll create calendar invite.
CalendarBot: Event created: "Maya's Birthday 1: Donuts + Chai Circle" 2026-07-14 09:30-10:15. Guests: people-ops, eng, sales.
Nina: Reactions are the vote: current tally :doughnut: 4, :tea: 6. Thanks! DM me if you want to help set up or assemble plant tags.
